topic: Explanation on clamping and bend radius of wire and cables
syllabus_extract: Explanation on clamping and bend radius of wire and cables.
specific_objectives: 19.1.1.1Trainee will be able to explain aircraft wiring and Causes of wiring degradation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of proper clamping techniques and measurement of minimum bend radius using sample wire bundles; Safety: Ensure no loose wires cause short circuits; Supervision: Instructor monitors tool usage and measurement accuracy.
intro_questions: What are the primary causes of aircraft wiring degradation?
Why is maintaining the correct bend radius critical for wire integrity?
How does improper clamping affect the electrical performance of a wire bundle?

Describe the minimum bend radius requirement for a standard aircraft wire.
Identify three signs of wiring damage caused by incorrect bending or clamping.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report outlining the steps to inspect a wire bundle for clamp-related degradation, referencing the guidelines in LP 12 regarding wire bundle breaks.
